resources.string: Live time since, or until, any date. Choose the style, colors and transparency for each widget.
Add a widget to your home screen

1. Tap Add next to the widget you want, or long-press an empty spot on your home screen and choose Widgets.
2. Place it. The five widgets are Time Since, Clock and Date, World Clock, Event Countdown and Month Calendar.
3. Choose its settings, colors and transparency, then tap Save widget.
4. Add as many as you like. Each one keeps its own settings, and tapping a widget on your home screen opens them again.
A big live clock with today\'s date. Choose 12 or 24 hour, seconds, colors and transparency.
Frosted-glass clock: your phone's time in a bright pill, the date, and two or three cities. Search any city or country, and choose names, colors and transparency.
Up to four events in one widget, each with the days left. Birthdays and anniversaries can repeat every year.
A month at a glance with today circled. Use the arrows to look at other months. Choose the first day of the week, colors and transparency.
About Time Since: Android cannot redraw a widget every second. Days, hours and the rest refresh every hour, while minutes and seconds tick live. Tap a widget any time to change it.
